steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat! What's your position?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Amiya, I am providing support to an L. G. D. team.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're about to engage!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Attention all elite operators: this may be our first, last, and only large-scale battle in Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone take objective one as your primary mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My team and I will be focusing on engaging the enemy commander.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want you all to remember: top priority is completing the terms of our contract, that is to work with the L. G. D. to ensure the security of Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Rhodes Island's mission in this battle is to reduce the friction between the Infected and uninfected people, to prevent clashes!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are Rhodes Island! No matter what else we carry into battle!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter when, no matter where!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And of course, if at any point our operations fall outside our standards, we will put a stop to them at once!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As such, we go into battle with a heavy burden of responsibility on our shoulders.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That was for my sake, huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's such a worrywart...

options: We'd better speed up, or we won't make it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You saw what tough customers those Infected were back there. That's a lot for one operator, or even one team to handle.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I really should've put that kid to bed once and for all back on the rooftop.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, copy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you don't get your butt to the ambush point, I'll take all of last year's disciplinary reports and hand them over to Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Settle down! I'll be there right on time!

options: Could you put me down when you take a call?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What am I supposed to do? We have to hurry...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (You'll pay for that one!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why so quiet, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ......Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I didn't do anything! It's the Doctor who clammed up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Tell her already!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Come on, say something...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, Doctor. I forgot you and Blaze would definitely go at it like this...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I do what I gotta do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why are you so pleased with yourself?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Anyway, all I need is your location and current operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You two seem to be getting along.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sure are!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Really?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Wait, what's happening here? What should I tell her?)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (This is bad! Red alert! I'm taking psychic damage! I need guidance!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Keep at it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She hung up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh no. We're in trouble.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But at least we're here. Let's take a load off.

options: But this is the highest point in the district?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well... shit.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You know what they say, the shortest distance between two points is a straight line. Let's hop down.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yep. Yawn.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hold on... If I'm not mistaken... That's Mephisto's team over there to the east, moving to the ambush zone.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And over there... the scaly kid?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He's taking his team to fight something. What is all that black there?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Is that the herd...? With those numbers?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Looks like we can't rest here, Doctor. Let's go. Time for the final battle!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Amiya. Hey!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm taking the Doctor into the fight!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We let a small Reunion group go, then we track them into the slums.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Weren't you leaving that to the special forces?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No reason we can't take the opportunity.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've already looked into the situation once and one thing is clear: as long as we're there, the special forces can't act openly.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Once the fighting stops, they won't be able to do much.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're not worried about orders from the top?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who's going to stand up and take responsibility for the team?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: All right, so you've got it all figured out. What's going on in the slums?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My informants have been busy. There's a few sectors I haven't been able to contact, but we have a lot more intelligence than anyone else.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This is a big gamble. But I guess we have no choice.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L. G. D. is the only group that can face down the special forces.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya, do you copy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, we're in position!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Mmhm.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I need to apologize for the whole ordeal with Reunion scooping up the Infected. That wouldn't have happened if we'd been more thoughtful.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's thanks to the L. G. D.'s quick action in the slums that Lungmen is able to plan against Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On a strategic level, I think you're fine, Officer Ch'en. But personally...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, Misha is dead.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And I can't condone your opinions of the Infected. Even you know...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Lungmenites who love their city will fight for her, no matter who they are.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wow, what an awesome little bunny.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did I just hear Miss Swire?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't mind her.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I agree with you, Amiya. Fighting for Lungmen can unite the people... except those tied up with Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But actually living in Lungmen is another matter. Time can't solve everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course. We have to solve everything ourselves.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wishful thinking. The Infected and uninfected live in different worlds.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not wishful thinking, Officer Ch'en. It's thinking about Misha, and the countless other Infected who died just like her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It was the gap between those two worlds that killed them. Are we going to let that divide define us? Are we not going to fight to bridge it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope you can understand, Officer Ch'en, why it is that the Infected and uninfected of Rhodes Island come together to fight for Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're here, Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Prepare for battle.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: It's an ambush! The L. G. D. is pushing us in!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Push through to the slums. Even though we haven't heard from Crownslayer... the slums are our only way out.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Take him.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: What are you going to do?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Me and a few teams have encouraged the 'herd' to gather up here.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: They won't attack me, so I can fight alongside them.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Fire in the hole!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We can't hold for long!

steps.name: Herd
steps.text: Ugh... Guhhh!!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: It's those special Infected! Look out!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You'll bring up the rear?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You're not coming back.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Mmm! Mmhhh!!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Let him speak. He can't do his Arts like this.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What are you doing?! You can't do this! Come back! Please! Come back here!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You once told me you would do anything I asked you.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sasha!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You said you don't want to make decisions for yourself.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: It's just, if you have your own ideas and your own goals now... I can't blame you for your choices.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: If that's the way it is, Mephisto... Well, that's great.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I'm out of options.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: So let me tell you my last wish.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sasha...? What are you talking about? I don't understand!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Don't let them escape! Take out their commanders!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...The Rhodes Island swallow?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (Mouthing 'pull the trigger.')

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Hit the deck! Watch the crossfire! We've got them surrounded!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Fall back, Rhodes Island crossbowman! This corridor is ours!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust! Run!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Crossbowmen, I know FrostNova is on her way. And even though Crownslayer is missing, her people are out there in the slums somewhere.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: When FrostNova gets here, you're under her command.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I trust her. Once she arrives, you'll be okay.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: And with my Originium Arts, you'll be invisible.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You can't, Faust! That will rupture your organs!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Doesn't matter. There's no reason not to do it anymore.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Retreat. That's an order.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: And take him with you. But not to Chernobog.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...Faust...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You can't do this!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I hope you survive. Even on your own.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Don't die.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ——That's my last wish.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sasha! Sashaaaaa!!!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I don't want to hurt anyone. I don't want to get anyone hurt.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I wish we had just run away, back then.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We could have... just run away.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sasha, you promised! We promised each other! We swore we would survive together!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: It's too late... for me...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...I'm too tired.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sashaaaaaa!!!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Goodbye, Eno.
He nocks a bolt into his crossbow, and winds it.
He takes aim, for the last time.
